questionEn: Which statement about “of the following are pure substances” is correct?
questionUz: “Quyidagilardan toza moddalar” haqidagi qaysi fikr to‘g‘ri?
explanationEn: Pure: nitrogen, oxygen, sugar, iron; the rest are mixtures.
explanationUz: Sof: azot, kislorod, shakar, temir; qolganlari aralashmalardir.
